notes.title: bug fix, improvement and new features
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New ambiance sounds added.
[*] Slap fish have been added. Now you have to fight a little more in the sea.
[*] Tutoria has been slightly improved.
[*] Fixed the freezing issue when caught in a shark.
[*] Improved the physics-based issue of losing artifacts.
[*] The driving experience of the bot has been improved on the gamepad side.
[/list]
